name: linear-array-simple
description: Ladder for the configurable linear+grid array (PC-ARRAY-GAP). Rungs: (1) inspector Linear-array panel hidden in Simple, visible in Pro; (2) panel layout/themes; (3) place a 1-D row; (4) place a 2-D grid; (5) overflow toast when copies don't fit.

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.()

steps.name: verify-linear-hidden-simple
steps.eval: (function(){ const panel = document.querySelector('.act-array--linear'); if (panel) throw new Error('Linear-array UI should be hidden in Simple mode but is visible'); console.log('PASS: linear array hidden in Simple'); })()

steps.name: verify-linear-visible-pro
steps.eval: (function(){ const panel = document.querySelector('.act-array--linear'); if (!panel) throw new Error('Linear-array UI (.act-array--linear) should be visible in Pro mode'); console.log('PASS: linear array visible in Pro'); })()

steps.name: set-row-count
steps.eval: (function(){ const set=(el,v)=>{ Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(Object.getPrototypeOf(el),'value').set.call(el,String(v)); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true})); }; const cols=document.querySelector('input[aria-label="Number of columns (total including source)"]'); set(cols,4); const rows=document.querySelector('input[aria-label="Number of rows (total including source)"]'); set(rows,1); })()

steps.name: set-grid-config
steps.eval: (function(){ const set=(el,v)=>{ Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(Object.getPrototypeOf(el),'value').set.call(el,String(v)); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true})); }; set(document.querySelector('input[aria-label="Number of columns (total including source)"]'),3); set(document.querySelector('input[aria-label="Number of rows (total including source)"]'),2); set(document.querySelector('input[aria-label="Column spacing centre-to-centre in metres"]'),0.7); set(document.querySelector('input[aria-label="Row spacing centre-to-centre in metres"]'),0.7); })()

steps.name: set-overflow-config
steps.eval: (function(){ const set=(el,v)=>{ Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(Object.getPrototypeOf(el),'value').set.call(el,String(v)); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true})); }; set(document.querySelector('input[aria-label="Number of columns (total including source)"]'),40); set(document.querySelector('input[aria-label="Number of rows (total including source)"]'),1); const sel=document.querySelector('select[aria-label="Array column direction"]'); Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(Object.getPrototypeOf(sel),'value').set.call(sel,'right'); sel.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true})); })()

steps.name: wait-overflow-toast
steps.failMessage: Expected a dropped-copy toast when arraying into a wall
